notes.title: Oculus Touch Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We've been hard at work over the past few months, and we're happy to say that we're a launch title for the Oculus Touch controllers! In addition, we added support for the Oculus headset with a gamepad, which should allow those without the touch to still be able to play the game in VR.

Update Highlights

Oculus Touch support
Oculus + gamepad support
Performance and usability improvements


For the full patch notes, head to this forum post.

notes.title: Home Improvisation: Patch 1
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who has played our game since release! Because of your feedback, we were able to identify and fix a bunch of bugs, as well as add some improvements to the overall experience. Here's a list of what's in this patch:

Improvements

 General: You no longer have to build the first two pieces of furniture to  access the radial menu
 General: The exit menu will appear if you hit the ESC key
 General: You can change the camera angle in a room by pressing MMB on mouse or Y on controllers
 VR: Collision haptic feedback disabled while in Dollhouse Mode
 VR: Controller model is invisible while holding objects in Dollhouse Mode
 VR: Networked VR players will turn transparent while in Dollhouse Mode


Bug Fixes

 General: Fixed edge cases regarding serialization
 General: Fixed issue where the camera would detach if ENTER was pressed
 General: Updated Help window to have correct controls
 General: Fixed issue where wall-mounted objects would only re-mount at the same point
 General: Fixed issue where swivel-jointed objects would occassionally rotate on incorrect axis
 Achievements: "Challenger Approaching" now correctly unlocks after beating all challenges
 Achievements: "Virtuoso" now correctly unlocks after pressing all piano keys
 Achievements: "D-D-D-Drop the Vase!" now correctly unlocks after shattering a vase
 Challenge Mode: Fixed off-center UIs
 Challenge Mode: Fixed levels sometimes exiting incompletely
 Workshop: Fixed issue where uploading UI was frozen after uploading one piece
 VR: Fixed issues where "Non-VR" launch option would still use VR
 VR: Mallet now properly breaks swivel connections


Known Issues

 General: Game sometimes launches on incorrect display. Hold SHIFT while launching to access a dialog that allows you to choose the display
 Online: Pieces on visiting player's are sometimes offset when a connection is made.
 Online: Players cannot play with other players if they are in different regions


Let me know if you have experienced any bugs not listed here, or if you have suggestions for improvements to the game!

notes.title: Home Improvisation Full Release!
notes.notes:
http://www.homeimprovisation.com/press/images/trailer_2.png

After 14 months in Early Access, we are finally ready to bring everyone's favorite furniture simulator to the masses. A huge thank you to everyone who supported us during our development, we couldn't have done it without you!

For those of you who played the game in Early Access, here are the biggest changes:

 6 rooms, including completely redone versions of the original rooms
 HTC Vive support, including local and online multiplayer
 New SFX and music
 More bug-fixes and gameplay improvements then we could list

notes.title: Home Improvisation: Full Release Delivered, Some Assembly Required
notes.notes:
Remember how angry I got while building a chair in Ikea-esque furniture build-em-up Home Improvisation [official site] while it was in Early Access? Well, the game is launching its Full Normal Regular Access version (technical term) and has been reworked in ways that will ALLEGEDLY make me far less angry and obsessed with building and rebuilding the same hell chair for a week.
 … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Huge Changes Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Home Improvisation has had a great run on Early Access, but our team has been working tirelessly to get the game ready for a full release. Here is an update on the future of our game.

Full Release Soon!

http://i.imgur.com/k2fJgOg.gif

We're not quite ready to announce the exact release date, but the game will leave Early Access within the next two months. There's so much new content, visual updates, and stability improvements that we know you'll fall in love with furniture building all over again.


Full HTC Vive Support at Release!

http://i.imgur.com/EHf9Y0e.gif

Ever since our team got our hands on the HTC Vive, we knew our game would be perfect for it. Building furniture in VR is an incredible experience, and we're happy to announce that we will have full support for the Vive when we leave Early Access. Even better: couch players can play along with the VR player!

Thanks so much for supporting us during development! May the Bork be with you!

notes.title: Online Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
Hello Steam! It's been a while, but we've been hard at work creating a quality update. This update comes with what is probably our most requested feature: online multiplayer! Now you can seamlessly decorate your home with either your friends or any random stranger.

****NOTE****
This update will clear save data automatically. This was an unfortunate necessity for online play, as our old save files do not provide enough information to properly reconstruct rooms.

Features

Online Multiplayer
 Build furniture with people over the internet!
 Play with your friends, or with total strangers who will definitely not mess up your house
 To begin online play, select the top option from the radial menu


Reworked Attic

 Play a full 88-key piano in the Attic!
 Use the multi-setting metronome to keep in time
 Shed some light on your creations with the new hanging bulb 


Improvements

 Enjoy a new theme song for Home Improv, courtesy of developer AJ Kolenc
 Compressed assets for faster load time
 Moved help dialog to Options menu


Bug Fixes

 Completely serialized state of rooms, including trash can and tools
 Fixed connection edge cases
 Fixed shattering edge cases

Bug fixes

 Fixed connections between multiple player-held objects
 Re-introduced Chandlier into game flow
 Fixed edge case with multi-connections
 Fixed edge case with trash can and shattered objects
 Fixed paint brush selection issues
 Mouse no longer controls Gamepad players' UIs

 Piece highlights are no longer lost
 Steam Workshop tabs no longer appear when not connected to Steam
 Room transitions only after player actions have completed

notes.title: Home Improvision - September Update
notes.notes:
September brings a modest update, but with some heavily requested features.

New Features

Motorized Joints

http://www.thestorkburntdown.com/images/Fan.gif

 Create mechanical masterpieces with auto-rotating joints
 The Snurrsak floor fan comes with two such joints


Ceiling Mounting

http://www.thestorkburntdown.com/images/chandelier.gif

 Connect objects to the ceilings of every room
 Try hanging our new chandelier, the Takvan, in the dining room


Grinder Tool

http://www.thestorkburntdown.com/images/Grinder2.gif

 Allows for the removal of pegs and holes from furniture
 Access via the toolbox


Improvements

 Performance increased from upgrade to Unity 5.1
 Refactored code to decrease room load times


Bug Fixes

 Fixed inconsistent swivel joint behavior
 Fixed a few edge cases involving wall-mounting
 Increased radius of light probe in living room to prevent visual errors on ceiling

notes.title: August Update: Steam Workshop!
notes.notes:
We're kicking off August with a big update: we've added Steam Workshop functionality so you can share your creations with the world and get the most awesome furniture the world has to offer.


New Features

Steam Workshop

http://www.thestorkburntdown.com/img/August_workshopCreate.gif

 Create and share custom furniture creations, and subscribe to others on the Workshop to bring them into your home.
 Access subscribed items via Catalog, and create items via the radial menu (while holding furniture).


Catlateral Damage

http://www.thestorkburntdown.com/img/August_CatDmg2.gif

 Cats have invaded Home Improvisation! Use new cat hammer to wreak havok
 A cat always lands on its feet...


Additional Furniture

http://www.thestorkburntdown.com/img/August_Rockin.gif

 Added Burdell rocking chair to Living Room


Improvements

 Pieces can be rotated before being connected for additional precision. Hold the connection button to line up the piece, rotate the piece to the desired angle, and release to connect.
 A new message board in the main room provides easy access to patch notes. Check the board for updates over time


Bug Fixes

 Fixed occassional mallet errors
 Reduced outline size to improve rendering on complex objects
 Restored click sound on multi-connections

notes.title: June Update
notes.notes:
We're closing out June with a big update, bringing new features, improvements, and bug fixes to enhance your furniture building experience.

New Features

Garbage Can

http://i.imgur.com/F3ezVyt.png?1

 Have spare parts lying around and want them to go away? Just open the Garbage Can and drop them in.
 Featuring fully-closable lid to prevent accidental destruction.
 If you do accidentally trash something, you can undo your last removal. Once you throw out something else, though, the original item is gone forever! 


Multi-connections

http://i.imgur.com/sLSrFlO.png?1

 Before you could only connect one hole to one peg: now, you can attach as many connectors as are spatially possible!
 Allows perfectionists to build furniture like the Fhqwhgads and the Arbetsskada without missing a single connection


Shatter Challenge

http://i.imgur.com/yKWXUMv.png?1

 A new function mode level!
 Use the hammer to shatter as many items as possible
 Play with friends to get a better score


Improvements

 The Height Challlenge has been significantly reworked, now keeping track of your best height instead of your best time.
 The Arbetsskada has been modified so that it fits together correctly now (especially with the new multi-connections).
 Almost all furniture is paintable now, allowing greater customization of your homes.
 The hammer can now target shatterable objects (Ting, Aard)


Bug Fixes

 Optimized furniture piece movement to prevent FPS drops when moving large objects.
 Fixed a few unhandled edge cases with Wall-Mounting, should be behave consistently across rooms.
 Swivel joints no longer drag the attached object down when held.
 Fixed Height Challenge error where pieces were not being removed when a new level started.


If you have any suggestions or bugs, please let us know and we'd be happy to address them!

notes.title: Patch Notes: June 1st
notes.notes:
We have a small update today with some bug fixes.

[olist]
 The Gluten (round table) no longer follows you when you change rooms
 The UIs for the Paint Brush, Light Switch, and Toolbox no longer disappear after the game loses focus (minimized, alt+tabbed)
 Textures on furniture display properly when an object is selected
 Audio volume sliders now properly save and display their values
[/olist]

Thanks for catching these, please let us know if you find any more!
